rationale: Two major defects require resolution: a one-frame backdrop flash introduced by the unconditional setPosition(null) call (fixable with a one-line change), and a timing ambiguity in how the prebuilt-assistants condition is evaluated at startFlow time. One additional patch finding: the duplicate data-onboarding attribute in NavigationAssistants.tsx was not removed and could spotlight the wrong element when both components are active. Decision_needed on CR-001 drives low confidence; a human must confirm whether silent step-skipping on race is acceptable or whether lazy evaluation is required.

business_review.criterion: Step 11 no longer freezes — backdrop disappears when prebuilt-assistants element is absent
business_review.notes: setPosition(null) fires immediately on target change; when getElementPosition returns null the component returns null and the backdrop is gone.

business_review.criterion: Condition correctly reflects element presence — returns false when section not mounted
business_review.notes: New condition () => !!document.querySelector('[data-onboarding="prebuilt-assistants"]') is true only when the data attribute is present in the DOM.

business_review.criterion: data-onboarding attribute is on an element that is mounted only when assistants are available
business_review.notes: NavigationPinnedSection renders the attribute inside helpAssistantsFetched && allItems.length > 0 guard. Note: NavigationAssistants.tsx:107 still carried the same attribute (CR-003, now fixed).
navigationIntroductionConditions.test.ts covers both absent and present DOM states.

business_review.criterion: Tests cover attribute presence/absence in NavigationPinnedSection
business_review.notes: NavigationPinnedSection.test.tsx new describe block covers helpAssistantsFetched=false (absent) and true+items (present).

business_review.criterion: OnboardingSpotlight clears stale position when target changes to missing selector
business_review.notes: OnboardingSpotlight.test.tsx third test verifies stale-position clearing on target prop change.

standards_review.notes: All 4 feature commits use EPMCDME-13785: Capital sentence format. Fix/Move/Apply/Add all pass regex.
.ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md not present. No lint/type errors observed in pre-commit output.
No auth, secrets, injection, or unsafe handling in the diff. Changes are UI/DOM only.

findings.problem: The prebuilt-assistants step condition is evaluated eagerly via Promise.all inside startFlow. The new condition checks document.querySelector('[data-onboarding="prebuilt-assistants"]') which returns false if helpAssistants have not loaded yet at the moment startFlow is called. When false, the step is silently dropped from the flow.
findings.impact: If the welcome tour starts before helpAssistantsFetched becomes true, step 11 is silently omitted. Whether this is acceptable UX or a silent regression requires a product decision.
findings.recommendation: Accept silent skip with a comment (option A), or refactor to lazy per-step evaluation (option B). User chose to defer to a follow-up ticket.

findings.problem: OnboardingSpotlight.useEffect calls setPosition(null) unconditionally then updatePosition() only sets position when element found. Produces two renders: null (backdrop gone) then found (backdrop back). Visible flash on normal step transitions.
findings.impact: Steps with present targets show a brief backdrop flicker on every step advance.
findings.recommendation: Use setPosition(getElementPosition(target)) atomically in updatePosition. Fixed in follow-up commit.

findings.problem: NavigationAssistants.tsx:107 still carried data-onboarding="prebuilt-assistants". When both NavigationAssistants and NavigationPinnedSection are active simultaneously, document.querySelector returns the first match — potentially the wrong element.
findings.impact: Spotlight could highlight NavigationAssistants instead of NavigationPinnedSection in configurations where both render.
findings.recommendation: Remove attribute from NavigationAssistants.tsx. Fixed in follow-up commit.
